locked_constraints: Use the age-20 standard portrait as the primary identity reference and preserve recognizable facial structure, face shape, major facial proportions, blue eyes, dark blue-black hair, and intended adult body proportions.
Present Inaria clearly as a healthy adult woman age 20 with natural Taiwanese/Asian facial presentation; no childlike cues or age drift.
Use the approved deep teal wrap blouse, warm-gray high-waisted pleated skirt, small silver earrings, and simple warm-gray closed-toe flats.
Keep the face, forehead, hairline, eyes, neck, and facial silhouette unobstructed.
Use the approved upright seated three-quarter pose on a visibly supporting muted stone bench.
Keep one forearm resting on the thigh and the other hand lightly holding the skirt edge; keep both hands visible and separated from fabric.
Each visible hand must have exactly five plausible, separated, correctly attached fingers.
Keep both knees, shins, ankles, and feet readable, distinct, anatomically continuous, and grounded.
If toes are visible, each foot must have exactly five plausible toes; closed-toe flats may limit direct toe visibility but must show natural foot volume and contact.
Use an eye-level approximately 50mm-equivalent medium-full view from head through feet with adequate margins and no wide-angle distortion.
Keep the subject slightly off-center and the conservatory background secondary, uncluttered, correctly scaled, and away from anatomy-critical regions.
Use soft diffused camera-left daylight with gentle frontal fill; preserve facial planes, natural skin texture, clothing color, and anatomy readability.
No extra limbs, duplicated subjects, impossible joints, severe twisting, floating feet, unstable balance, text, watermark, logo, signage, mirror, reflection duplicate, or distracting prop.
Final candidate must pass identity, age presentation, anatomy, quality, variation, caption, metadata, and traceability checks.

notes.quality_gate: PASS only when identity remains recognizable, age reads as 20, hair remains dark blue-black, eyes remain blue, facial structure and adult proportions remain stable, both hands pass the exact-five-finger check, both feet and ankles are natural and grounded, the face is unobstructed, clothing and environment are coherent, and the camera framing is non-distorted.
notes.repair_policy: Any repaired candidate receives a new lineage record containing parent candidate ID, repair operation, revised parameters, and output hash, followed by a complete recheck of identity, age, hair, eyes, facial structure, body proportions, clothing construction, hands, fingers, wrists, elbows, knees, ankles, feet, toes where visible, balance, bench and floor contact, camera, lighting, background overlaps, text, watermark, duplicates, and other artifacts.
traceability_requirements: Preserve exact prompt text and all generation parameters.
Link the candidate to the approved CHARACTER, CLOTHING, SCENE, and POSE_CAMERA handoff records.
Store reference asset identifiers and conditioning strengths.
Record visual gate results and rejection reasons if not accepted.
